title: Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy-MT2: compact translation models for 33 languages
friendlyTitle: Hy-MT2 offers translation models for 33 languages
summary: Hy-MT2 is a family of 1.8-billion, 7-billion and mixture-of-experts translation models supporting 33 languages and instruction-following translation. The repository gained 147 stars in the day’s GitHub Trending snapshot, and Tencent says extreme quantisation can reduce the smallest model to about 440MB for on-device use.
friendlySummary: Hy-MT2 includes several model sizes for translation and can follow extra instructions about the result. A compressed version of the smallest model may fit on local devices.
whyItMatters: Developers can evaluate Hy-MT2 for local or private translation, including subtitles and domain-specific instructions, without routing every document to a commercial API. Check the model licence, benchmark claims and quality for the exact language pair and terminology before production use.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It may help apps translate private text locally. Test it with the languages and specialist words your users actually need.
